prompt: A circuit uses XOR to conditionally flip a data bit. Which statements are true?

options.text: A low control preserves the data bit
options.explanation: Correct. XOR with zero leaves either data value unchanged.

options.text: A high control flips the data bit
options.explanation: Correct. XOR is high when its two inputs differ.

options.text: Applying the same control twice restores the original bit
options.explanation: Correct. Two flips cancel; two unchanged passes also preserve the bit.

options.text: Equal data and control inputs make XOR high
XOR and OR agree when both inputs are high
options.explanation: OR is high there, but XOR is low.

workedExample: Consider the control first. Low means no flip; high means flip. Repeating either operation twice restores the starting value. The case with two high inputs distinguishes XOR from OR.
